system_description.narrative_title: Post-midterm political realignment and its global ripples
system_description.narrative_summary: A decisive Democratic midterm outcome is reshaping U.S. political power and empowering oversight while constraining presidential latitude, even as acute geopolitical flashpoints (Iran/Houthi strikes, Russia–Ukraine) and turbulence in the tech/AI sector (market routs, corporate governance probes) create cross-cutting economic and security feedbacks. The news window shows an open system where electoral change, legal investigations, market sentiment and kinetic incidents interact and amplify one another, producing second‑order effects on energy markets, defense policy and corporate strategy. Expect ongoing interactions as domestic politics alter foreign policy signaling and markets price shifting regulatory and geopolitical risk.
system_description.scope: The interactions among U.S. electoral outcomes and congressional power, executive politics and investigations, global security incidents (esp. Middle East and Russia–Ukraine), tech/AI sector shocks (market movements and governance probes), and near-term economic/energy market responses.
system_description.super_system: Global political–economic–security order linking great‑power rivalry, international markets and transnational institutions
adjacent_subsystems: U.S. domestic politics and institutions (Congress, presidency, legal/oversight processes)
Global security hotspots (Iran/Houthi conflicts, Russia–Ukraine tensions, NATO planning)
Technology and financial markets (AI sector, Nvidia governance probe, tech-stock rout)
Energy and commodity markets (oil supply, attacks on energy infrastructure, Saudi/region stability)
evidence_headlines: Democrats Win Victories on a Historic Scale
Democrats vow to impeach Trump officials and investigate Republican donors
Exclusive | U.S. Strikes Iran’s Qeshm Island as Trump Talks Down War Risks
Saudi Aramco office in Riyadh damaged in latest Houthi strikes
Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy
Instant View: Tech-stock rout accelerates retreat from the AI trade

variables.name: Legislative–executive power balance
variables.description: The relative distribution of formal political authority between the legislative body and the executive office at a given time.

variables.name: Executive policy autonomy
variables.description: The degree of unconstrained decision-making latitude available to the chief executive for domestic and foreign policy choices.

variables.name: Legislative oversight activity
variables.description: The rate at which legislative actors initiate hearings, subpoenas, and oversight actions concerning executive or private-sector conduct.

variables.name: Intensity of legal and prosecutorial probes
variables.description: The aggregate frequency and resource intensity of formal investigations, prosecutions, and judicial inquiries into public- and private-sector actors.

variables.name: Geopolitical tension level
variables.description: The prevailing degree of interstate strategic rivalry and diplomatic strain across major international actors and regions.

variables.name: Rate of kinetic security incidents
variables.description: The frequency of armed attacks, strikes, and other kinetic military events occurring across contested theaters.

variables.name: Technology-sector market volatility
variables.description: The level of price and valuation volatility concentrated in the technology and related high-growth sectors.

variables.name: Corporate governance scrutiny
variables.description: The intensity and prevalence of investigatory, regulatory, and market-led scrutiny of corporate leadership and practices.

variables.name: Regulatory policy uncertainty
variables.description: The perceived unpredictability about future regulatory changes that affect firms and markets.

variables.name: Investor risk appetite
variables.description: The aggregate market participants' willingness to assume financial risk across asset classes.

variables.name: Energy market risk premium
variables.description: The additional price or premium embedded in energy markets reflecting geopolitical, supply and policy risk expectations.

variables.name: Defense posture and readiness
variables.description: The measured level of deployed forces, readiness capabilities, and logistical posture available for military response.

variables.name: Policy signaling coherence
variables.description: The consistency and clarity of public policy messages and signals emanating from the policymaking system.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flow volatility
variables.description: The variability and rate of international capital movements into and out of domestic financial markets.

variables.name: Public trust in institutions
variables.description: The population's aggregate confidence in political and civic institutions to act effectively and legitimately.

variables.name: Frequency of cyber incidents
variables.description: The rate at which disruptive cyber intrusions, breaches, and state‑level cyber operations occur against critical targets.

catalysts.title: Democratic-led congressional probes
catalysts.description: New Democratic majorities initiate sustained oversight, subpoenas and investigations into Trump officials, donors and corporate actors.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Democrats vow to impeach Trump officials...", "Democrats plan probes of Musk, Miller...", "Democratic senator demands tech firms..."

catalysts.title: Tech-sector hearings and corporate probes
catalysts.description: Congressional scrutiny and potential regulatory action targeting big tech (and linked corporate governance issues) intensify after midterms and scandal reports.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Democratic senator demands tech firms...", "Democrats plan probes of Musk...", "Nvidia board will probe CEO..."

catalysts.title: Nvidia board investigation
catalysts.description: Nvidia's board probe into CEO Jensen Huang's alleged relationship and potential foreign-spy ties becomes an active corporate governance case.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Nvidia's board will probe CEO Huang's relationship...", "Nvidia investigates CEO Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy"

catalysts.title: NATO new defense-plan rollout
catalysts.description: Allies begin implementing a new NATO defense posture that contemplates deeper strikes into Russia, changing force posture and planning.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "NATO’s New Defense Plan Would Mean Strikes Deep Inside Russia", "UK must ‘catch up’ with Europe..."

catalysts.title: Israeli government formation attempt
catalysts.description: A contested attempt to form a new Israeli government (Eisenkot's bid) will determine coalition composition and the country's policy posture.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Israel’s president gives Gadi Eisenkot first chance at forming a government", "Netanyahu rival Eisenkot seeks 'wide' government..."

catalysts.title: Continued Houthi strikes on Gulf targets
catalysts.description: Houthi missile/drone campaign against Saudi and maritime targets persists, prompting military responses and regional security measures.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Saudi Aramco office in Riyadh damaged...", "Iconic Saudi Tower Hit as Yemen’s Houthis Target Riyadh", "Houthi-run health ministry says airstrikes kill 33..."

catalysts.title: G7 ministers meet on cyber attacks
catalysts.description: G7 foreign/defense ministers convene to coordinate responses to recent state-linked cyber attacks and raise collective cyber policy focus.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "G7 ministers to discuss recent cyber attacks, Italy says", "Hacks expose the flaws of the connected world"

catalysts.title: State-level Democratic trifecta policy rollouts
catalysts.description: New Democratic trifectas at the state level push regulatory and fiscal changes, creating varied policy experiments and contagion effects.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "See Democrats’ Historic Statehouse Wins and Their New ‘Trifectas’", "How Democrats will try to end Trump's tariffs"

catalysts.title: Market volatility from tech rout and midterms
catalysts.description: Investor flows and valuations react to the tech selloff and midterm outcomes, driving short-term volatility and shifting risk appetite.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Instant View: Tech-stock rout accelerates...", "Cryptocurrencies slide to two-month lows after US midterms", "Stocks are moving in sync again..."
